description: PRIMARY rules — used always for lab interpretation

rules: TSH first-line marker for thyroid function
Use anti-TPO and anti-TG together when autoimmune thyroid disease is suspected
Low Hb + low MCH suggests iron deficiency / anemia pattern
Low reticulocytes with low Hb supports iron deficiency
Do not diagnose from CBC alone without context
Use laboratory's own reference ranges when available
Do not override primary TSH/freeT4 interpretation by derived indices alone
Eosinophilia interpret directly before any derived index
Max 3 hypotheses to user; no rare diagnoses without symptom support
